info.title: DecisionLane API
info.description: API for submitting refund claims, uploading evidence, and reviewing refund assessments. Protected operations use Microsoft Entra bearer tokens.

post.description: Creates a claim for an order owned by the signed-in customer. The requested amount and currency must be compatible with the paid order.

400.description: The request is invalid or violates a business rule.

401.description: The bearer token is missing or invalid.

403.description: The authenticated user does not have a required role.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

get.description: Customers receive only their own claims. Reviewers and Admins can list claims across customers. Optionally filter by the claim status string.

401.description: The bearer token is missing or invalid.

403.description: The authenticated user does not have a required role.

get.description: Returns a claim to its owning Customer or to an authenticated Reviewer or Admin. A customer who does not own the claim receives a not-found response.

401.description: The bearer token is missing or invalid.

403.description: The authenticated user does not have a required role.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

post.description: For the owning Customer, creates a short-lived direct-to-Blob upload grant for evidence belonging to the claim. Upload the file to `upload_url` using the returned `required_headers`; the Blob request is not an API operation.

post.description: For the owning Customer, verifies the uploaded Blob size, content type, file signature, and file structure before marking the document as verified.

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: Reviewer decision; must be either `approve` or `reject`.

order_id.title: Order Id
order_id.description: Identifier of an order owned by the signed-in customer.

claim_type.description: Reason category for the refund claim.

requested_amount.title: Requested Amount
requested_amount.description: Requested refund amount; must not exceed the amount paid for the order.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency code, which must match the order.

customer_id.title: Customer Id
customer_id.description: Entra object ID of the customer who owns the order.

payment_intent_id.title: Payment Intent Id
payment_intent_id.description: Payment provider reference for the order.

UploadGrant.title: UploadGrant
UploadGrant.description: Grant for uploading one file directly to quarantine Blob Storage.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: MIME content type of the evidence file.

size_bytes.title: Size Bytes
size_bytes.description: File size in bytes; maximum is 4194304.

EntraBearer.description: Microsoft Entra access token for the DecisionLane API audience. Authorization uses the token's roles claim.
